title: Lemon Custard Delight
method: Combine sugar, oil, salt and flour.
Flour into an ungreased custard cup or a 1 quart casserole.
Set in pan of warm water and bake uncovered in a slow oven for approximately 40 minutes or until set when tested with a knife.
Serve warm or chilled, unmolded with whipped cream or non-dairy topping
